description: EO-based hazard flooding maps - South Sudan, 2012-2025 is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Use Case Name Flooding and health care service disruption in South Sudan. Dataset Name EO-based hazard flooding maps. Dataset Description The dataset covers the period 2012–2025 and provides hazard flooding maps derived from VIIRS data at 375 m/pixel, where each pixel represents the fraction of water coverage. Coverage: South Sudan. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
